lesson.Title: 新單字和閱讀理解
lesson.Grammar_Focus: 動詞後接不定詞 (to V) 與動名詞 (V-ing) 的用法與語意差異 (stop / remember / forget / try)
lesson.Reading_Title: A Difficult Career Choice (Grammar & Vocabulary Focus)
lesson.Reading_Passage:
In a complete English sentence, a main clause generally has only one main verb. When expressing a second action, we transform the verb into an infinitive (to V) or a gerund (V-ing). Verbs like want, plan, decide, hope, need, and refuse take "to V" for future intentions (e.g., The strict boss refused to hire workers who gave up easily).

Conversely, verbs like enjoy, practice, finish, keep, and give up take "V-ing" to show ongoing experiences (e.g., Kevin enjoys visiting his distant relatives in Canada during vacation).

Finally, four core verbs—stop, remember, forget, and try—change their meanings completely depending on whether they are followed by "to V" or "V-ing". For example, "stop to V" means pausing one action to do another, while "stop V-ing" means quitting an ongoing action altogether.

vocab.Example: The hardworking salesman plans to meet the branch manager before noon to show the new digital products.
The tech company boss told the software engineer not to turn off the main system during office hours.
After crossing the broken bridge, the brave soldiers stopped to rescue the scared travelers from the falling rocks.
The Colombian coffee farmer hopes to harvest all the crops before the heavy rainy season arrives.
When the weather screen showed a warning, the experienced fisherman decided not to sail into the dangerous storm.
During his summer vacation in Canada, Kevin enjoyed visiting his distant relatives in Montreal.
The skilled mechanic finished inspecting every machine in the car factory before the workers went home.
It is very exhausting for the truck driver to transport fresh food across the high mountains all night.
Some leaders refused to believe the climate report until the scientists showed the rising temperature data.
Although the young actor was nervous, he remembered to speak clearly after his teacher whispered, "Break a leg!"
Zac made up his mind not to give up learning computer programming even though the subject was tough.
It is not kind of you to make fun of Lucas just because he feels nervous on stage.
After updating his resume, Charles decided to start a new career in digital media.
The young musician kept practicing the violin pieces all night to prepare for tomorrow's big audition.
The delivery man stopped to check the fragile antique box to make sure it was still in good condition.

quiz.Question: After driving for five long hours in heavy rain, the delivery driver stopped ______ a short break at the gas station.
quiz.Explanation: stop to V 表示「停下原本開車的動作，轉而去做另一件事（休息一下）」。

quiz.Question: Don't worry! I clearly remember ______ the company's financial report to the manager's email yesterday afternoon.
quiz.Explanation: remember V-ing 表示「記得曾經做過某事（昨天下午已經寄出報告）」。

quiz.Question: The clever hacker tried ______ into the school system, but our new firewall successfully stopped him.
quiz.Explanation: try to V 表示「設法、努力嘗試達成某個具難度的目標（試圖駭入系統）」。

quiz.Question: When the emergency earthquake alarm blinked on the screen, all employees decided ______ inside the building.
quiz.Explanation: decide 後接不定詞 to V，其否定形式必須將 not 放在 to 的正前方，即 decide not to stay。

quiz.Question: Chloe has poor math grades; therefore, she gave up ______ soccer after school and spent more time studying.
quiz.Explanation: give up 為必接動名詞（V-ing）的片語動詞，故選 playing。
